title: core
juno-adx-client
text: This package wraps the small Azure authentication and query helpers that were originally sketched in the repo notebook. It keeps the runtime dependencies explicit and moves connection setup behind functions so imports stay safe in notebooks and modules.

title: juno-adx-client
text:
Developer Guide
The package source lives in nbs/00_core.ipynb and exports into juno_adx_client/core.py.

Install juno_adx_client in Development mode
$ pip install -e .[dev]

# export notebook changes into the package
$ nbdev_export

# run the full nbdev prep pipeline when Quarto is available
$ nbdev_prepare

title: juno-adx-client
text:
Usage

Installation
Install from the repo in editable mode while developing:
$ pip install -e .[dev]
Runtime dependencies include:

azure-identity
azure-kusto-data
azure-keyvault-secrets
pandas



Documentation
When Quarto is installed, nbdev can build docs from the notebooks and publish them to pages.

title: juno-adx-client
text:
How to use
Create an ADXClient from notebook variables and pass an explicit database plus either a raw KQL query or a table name.

from juno_adx_client import ADXClient

cluster_url = ...
database_name = ...
query_text = ...

client = ADXClient(cluster_url, interactive_login=True)
client.perform_query(query=query_text, database=database_name)
